plot_views_clones: plot a GitHub repository's unique views and clones over the last 2 weeks as a dual-axis chart
plot_high_traffic_resources: plot the top 10 most-visited resource paths in a GitHub repository as a horizontal bar chart
plot_commit_activity: plot the weekly commit count for the last 10 weeks of a GitHub repository as a bar chart
issue_activity_sankey: plot a Sankey diagram showing issue flow from creation through discussion and closure states
draw_all_plots: generate all traffic and issue trend plots for a GitHub repository and save them to an output folder
